title: review: T-0771 gate unblock (auto_fix_round missing-goal fallback; test harness isolates live pool.toml settings)
spec: Security-path review (orchestrator/daemon.py matches [review] security_paths) of branch task/T-0771 in worktree /Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/wt/T-0771, commits f601396 and 4ba6bb0 against goal/T-0760. Run every test command inside that worktree, never in the repository root (the root lacks these changes). Judge: (1) daemon.auto_fix_round never lets a build_ctx/route exception escape and falls back to the pre-existing routine path with a single notify warning; (2) tests/_harness.py rewrites the copied pool.toml so tests do not inherit the live autonomous flag or account B planner affinity, and the rewrite cannot corrupt other sections; (3) the new test test_auto_fix_round_survives_missing_goal_under_autonomous exercises the fallback; (4) no behaviour change outside tests when autonomous routing succeeds. Security checklist applies (daemon.py).
acceptance: verdict approve or request_changes with file:line comments
tests were run inside wt/T-0771, not the repo root

result.summary: Verified against live repo (HEAD already matches the diff): the try/except in auto_fix_round preserves the pre-existing fallback routine/ids/comments (set at daemon.py:168-175) when build_ctx/decision.route raises, only overwriting them on success, and build_ctx's first call is the bare bus.get(goal_id) so no partial mutation happens before the KeyError. The notify() message includes both the held task id and the missing goal id as required. Ran the three named tests directly (all pass) and the full gate via .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh, which exited 0 (1027 tests). _harness.py's section-scoped regex correctly isolates [planner] from [planner.routes] before forcing autonomous=false, and forces account B's role_affinity back to excluding "planner" so live config drift can't leak into fixtures. No correctness or security issues found.
